baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَخَذْنَا مِيثَاقَهُمْ ... فَنَسُوا ... فَأَغْرَيْنَا بَيْنَهُمُ الْعَدَاوَةَ وَالْبَغْضَاءَ
baseline_models.mechanism: A confirmed bond is taken, but neglect of a delimited share leaves the relational middle to be occupied by a replacement adhesive: incited enmity joined to aversion. The consequence is a malformed bond, not merely an absence of unity.

activation_trace.role: An emphatic covenant is literally a confirmed bond and supplies the relation that should organize the parties.
Leaving or neglecting literally broadens forgetting beyond failed recall and marks withdrawal from the bond.
A share or allotted portion makes the loss partial and supports selective abandonment rather than total erasure.
Glue and adhesion make the imposed hostility function as a replacement bond that sticks.
The connection between parties turns the relational middle into the substrate on which the replacement bond operates.
Enemy and enmity supply the antagonistic relation attached within that middle.
Inner aversion, literally the opposite of love, supplies the affect that keeps the hostile bond live.

changed_reading.before: They forgot teaching, so they were punished with discord.
changed_reading.after: They abandoned a bounded covenantal share, and the vacated connective bond was replaced by hostility that adheres within their relations.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نَسُوا حَظًّا مِمَّا ذُكِّرُوا بِهِ ... يُنَبِّئُهُمُ اللَّهُ بِمَا كَانُوا يَصْنَعُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The portion language blocks a total-memory reading. Leaving some entrusted reminder and continuously making or doing form a present process whose shape is disclosed later.

activation_trace.role: Neglect or abandonment makes the omission potentially practical and selective rather than merely cognitive.
An allotted share delimits what is omitted and preserves the remainder as a live contrast.
A reminder is literally what causes recollection and functions here as entrusted content repeatedly available to action.
Occurrence and presence in time give the final making a sustained past reality rather than an isolated deed.
Making and doing turn the omitted reminder into an observable pattern of produced conduct.
A consequential report supplies the later disclosure that renders the produced pattern explicit.

changed_reading.before: A community accidentally forgot some instruction and will later be told about its deeds.
changed_reading.after: A delimited part of entrusted reminder was left aside while conduct kept being produced; the later report exposes that selective pattern.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: الَّذِينَ قَالُوا إِنَّا نَصَارَى ... بِمَا كَانُوا يَصْنَعُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The opening designation is voiced as a first-person confessional claim, while the close shifts evaluation to what was continuously made. Identity speech and produced practice are therefore placed under one audit without declaring the name itself false.

activation_trace.role: Speech as belief or position makes the opening words a self-ascribed commitment rather than only an external label.
The communal and confessional designation supplies the identity being asserted.
General making and doing supplies the practical record against which the spoken identity is tested.
Crafted self-presentation remains a secondary possibility, sharpening the risk that appearance and produced conduct diverge.
The delivered report closes the audit by making the practical record known.

changed_reading.before: The verse names a group and then predicts judgment for its deeds.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a voiced communal self-ascription and then tests that asserted identity against the conduct its bearers kept producing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet opens with complete fulfillment of knotted obligations and later renders covenant remembrance as hearing that understands and obeys. This strengthens the focus reading of forgetting as failure to enact a binding relation.

activation_trace.role: The confirmed covenant supplies the focus bond whose practical force is being tested.
Neglect supplies the focus-side failure that the context recasts as nonperformance.
Full completion without deficiency gives covenant fidelity a concrete measure of enacted wholeness.
Binding ends into a knot materializes obligations as relations that must remain tied.
Hearing as understanding and compliance makes reception of the covenant operational.
Willing obedience supplies the action that completes hearing and keeps the bond effective.

structural_cues: 5:1 places fulfillment and contracts at the packet opening.
5:7 pairs remembrance of the covenant with the response that they heard and obeyed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies completion, knotting, compliant hearing, and obedience; I infer that forgetting in 5:14 can name failure to perform the bond, while ordinary memory loss remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: Forgetting is chiefly loss of remembered covenant content.
changed_reading.after: Forgetting is also the practical untying of a covenant that exists only as it is heard, obeyed, and fulfilled.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier commands treat antipathy as pressure that can become transgression and treat cooperation and justice as social gates that can redirect it. The focus hostility can therefore be read as a coordinated circuit of antagonistic conduct, not only private feeling.

activation_trace.role: Incitement and repeated urging make hostility behaviorally active rather than merely possessed.
Crossing a limit and wronging another gives enmity an actionable social output.
Aversion supplies the inward pressure that can feed the outward circuit.
Hatred and enmity name the same affective pressure while the verse explicitly constrains its behavioral result.
Mutual assistance is a relay that can carry either virtue or wrongdoing, supplying the social transmission mechanism.
Justice in judgment and conduct supplies the repeated gate that antipathy must not override.

structural_cues: 5:2 places hatred, transgression, and two opposed forms of cooperation in one sequence.
5:8 repeats the hatred warning and answers it with a doubled command to act justly.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies affective pressure, possible transgression, cooperative relays, and justice gates; I infer that the focus punishment operates through failed gates and coordinated conduct, while purely interpersonal dislike remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Enmity and hatred are imposed inner attitudes.
changed_reading.after: Enmity and hatred become a self-relaying social practice in which antipathy drives boundary crossing and recruits cooperation away from justice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding sequence supplies an unbuilding process: a fastened covenant is undone, hearts lose pliancy, words are tilted away from their placements, and the same partial forgetting formula follows. In the focus, hostile adhesion then appears as a replacement ordering after bond and language have been dislocated.

activation_trace.role: The confirmed covenant supplies the focus structure whose loss requires explanation.
Neglect supplies the repeated focus node that is relocated inside a larger breakdown process.
Undoing what was firmly built literally supplies the first structural rupture.
Loss of the heart's softness supplies the resistant medium in which correction no longer enters easily.
Tilting away from a direction makes verbal distortion a spatial displacement rather than simple absence.
A thing's assigned placement supplies the ordered location from which words are moved.

structural_cues: 5:12 states the taking of a covenant before 5:13 names its breach.
5:13 reproduces the focus clause about forgetting a share of what they were reminded of after breach, hardening, and displacement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an adjacent ordered sequence; I read it as a causal degradation chain that culminates in selective neglect, though the listed acts could instead be parallel symptoms of breach.

changed_reading.before: A discrete act of forgetting directly precedes discord.
changed_reading.after: Selective forgetting is one stage in an unbuilding chain: the bond is undone, receptivity hardens, words leave their places, and hostile adhesion becomes the substitute order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah places concealed written material, clarification, and illumination together. That sequence sharpens the focus ending into deferred disclosure: what is selectively omitted and continuously produced now will later be made explicit.

activation_trace.role: Selective neglect supplies the present withholding that the context's disclosure answers.
Ongoing making supplies the practical record awaiting disclosure.
The consequential report is the focus-side act that eventually makes the record known.
Written and ordered letters supply the textual corpus in which concealment and clarification operate.
Covering and hiddenness provide the present concealment that deferred notification reverses.
Making meaning clear by speech or sign supplies the explicit disclosure operation.
Illumination supplies the visibility under which concealed and manufactured patterns can be seen.

structural_cues: 5:15 immediately follows the focus and contrasts concealment with clarification.
The focus's future report follows selective omission and habitual making, forming a present-hidden versus later-shown temporal arc.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hiding, clarification, writing, and light; I infer that the final notification unmasks the relation between selective omission and produced acts, while a generic report of judgment remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The final sentence is a generic promise of future judgment.
changed_reading.after: The final sentence completes a disclosure arc: present selective concealment and manufactured conduct are eventually rendered plain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby recurrence of the same communal name appears inside another first-person status claim, being children and beloved, which is tested against sin and punishment. This strengthens the speech-act force of the focus opening without making every self-designation deceptive.

activation_trace.role: Speech as belief or position supplies the focus's confessional self-ascription.
The communal designation supplies the identity content of the opening claim.
Produced conduct supplies the practical criterion placed beside spoken identity.
A stated position frames the claim of filial and beloved status and its verbal challenge.
Recurrence of the same communal designation links that status claim back to the focus wording.
Love lodged in the heart supplies the claimed relational privilege.
Sin supplies the conduct-based counterweight by which asserted privilege is tested.

structural_cues: 5:17 and 5:18 both stage identity propositions with an explicit saying formula.
5:18 answers a claim of privileged relation by pointing to accountable conduct.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a voiced status claim and a love-versus-sin test; I infer analogous claim force in 5:14, while neutral self-identification remains a materially live reading.

changed_reading.before: Those who said they were Christians is simply a group label.
changed_reading.after: The wording foregrounds a spoken identity commitment whose relational claim is audited by covenantal conduct.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later request to separate between two parties places division directly inside the repeated relational middle. Returning to the focus, adhesive enmity does not merely sit at a location among people; it converts their connective interval into a working boundary.

activation_trace.role: Adhesion supplies the force that fixes the hostile arrangement in place.
The connection between parties supplies the relational medium that can be transformed.
Enmity supplies the antagonistic content installed in that medium.
Distinguishing and separating between two sides makes partition an explicit relational operation.
Separation and departure activate the repeated between as a boundary-producing interval.

structural_cues: 5:25 says to separate between us and between the transgressing people, repeating the locative relation around the requested division.
The focus places both enmity and hatred inside that same relational construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit separation plus a doubled between; I infer that the focus's relational middle is dynamically partitioned, while a simple locative sense of among remains available.

changed_reading.before: Enmity is placed at a location among separate individuals.
changed_reading.after: The connective interval itself is converted into a durable partition, so relation becomes the machinery of separation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates non-dominant mapped branches of the focus root for enmity. It remains anchored in the exact ع د و occurrence and is reinforced by adhesion and duration; downstream prose should present recurrence and contagion as lexical images for propagation, not as direct translations of العداوة.

activation_trace.role: Habit, training, and repeated practice make hostility capable of being continually reconstituted.
Transmission of disease supplies a contained image for hostility spreading through contact.
Adhesion explains how each recurrence can attach again within relations.
An extended duration supplies the temporal field across which recurrence and spread persist.

changed_reading.before: A stable state of hostility simply lasts until the final day.
changed_reading.after: Hostility may be repeatedly rehearsed and socially retransmitted, adhering anew across the whole duration.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the eschatological term through a bodily standing branch and connects it to a later narrative of refusing action. It remains anchored in the focus ق و م inventory and the explicit sitting of 5:24; downstream prose should keep it as a secondary posture contrast, never replace the primary resurrection sense.

activation_trace.role: Resurrection and the rising of creatures preserve the primary eschatological endpoint.
Bodily standing supplies the secondary posture that reverses entrenched sitting.
Duration makes the posture contrast stretch from present refusal to final rising.
Sitting back from action supplies the explicit counter-posture to rising.
Indefinitely long duration intensifies the declared refusal that the final endpoint overturns.
Stasis and continuance make refusal a settled posture rather than a momentary pause.

changed_reading.before: Until the day of resurrection is only a chronological limit.
changed_reading.after: The chronological limit also faintly reverses a covenantal posture: prolonged sitting back from action lasts toward the day of universal standing.

strongest_changes: Covenant forgetting shifted from memory lapse toward failure to enact and preserve a binding relation.
The exact 5:13 sequence placed selective forgetting inside breach, hardening, and verbal displacement.
Enmity and hatred became a replacement adhesive and a socially relayed boundary rather than only private emotions.
The final notification became deferred disclosure of selectively omitted reminder and continuously produced conduct.
summary.what_was_special: The densest activation was material and relational: contracts knot, covenants bind, incitement glues, and the space between parties can connect or divide. The split ع د و inventory also preserved recurrence and contagion as contained exploratory images.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus permits both involuntary lapse and deliberate practical abandonment under ن س ي.
The 5:13 sequence may be causal degradation or a cluster of parallel breach symptoms.
The saying formula may mark a loaded identity claim or ordinary self-identification.
The recurrence, contagion, and sitting-versus-rising activations remain branch-distant and should stay exploratory.
